facts.business: Harish Textile Engineers Limited is engaged in the business of textile engineering.

auditor.name: K. M. Swadia & Co.
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualified opinion due to: (a) default in redemption of NCDs (Series III and IV) and receipt of Event of Default notice from debenture trustee; (b) inability to validate interest liability computation for MSME vendors; (c) non-quantification of impact of non-reversal of input tax credit for suppliers unpaid beyond 180 days. Material uncertainty related to going concern due to negative net working capital of INR 1,649.25 Lakhs.

key_risks: Default on Non-Convertible Debentures (Series III and IV) and Event of Default notice from debenture trustee
Negative net working capital of INR 1,649.25 Lakhs indicating liquidity crunch
Unquantified interest liability for MSME vendors under MSMED Act
Non-reversal of input tax credit for suppliers unpaid beyond 180 days under CGST Act
Ongoing litigation: NCLT Petition No. 128 of 2022 with stay on proceedings
